records.text: Thaddius is undead and dwells in Naxxramas.
He says he must obey, threatens to kill and break opponents, and speaks of their pain. His voice also pleads for someone to hurry, save him and make the torment stop.
Grobbulus is an encounter boss who sprays slime across the room.
Gluth is an undead boss whose combat behavior centers on devouring nearby zombies and decimating nearby flesh. He becomes enraged and can enter a berserker rage.

Heigan the Unclean threatens intruders and warns that the end is near. He claims to see endless suffering, torment and rage, predicts that the world's races will perish, and taunts that hungry worms will feast on his foes.
Maexxna is a spider boss whose web is central to her predation: she wraps victims in cocoons, sprays strands across the area, and spiderlings appear on her web.

Grand Widow Faerlina commands acolytes in service to her master, insisting they abandon mortal desires and serve the cause without question. She glorifies dying in the master's service and urges them to slay in his name.
Noth the Plaguebringer calls on his soldiers to rise and fight again. He praises the master and threatens intruders, declares his task done when an enemy falls, and vows to serve the master in death.

Anub'Rekhan greets intruders with a parlor welcome, then taunts them as they face his attacks. He relishes their fear and flight, warns that there is no escape, and claims to hear their hearts beating faster. His speech gives this Naxxramas encounter a cruel, predatory presence.
Dread Creepers inhabit Naxxramas's Arachnid Quarter, where their encounter behavior includes casting a spell.
Carrion Spinners are found in Naxxramas's Arachnid Quarter. Their encounter behavior includes casting spells.
Venom Stalkers are part of Naxxramas's Arachnid Quarter encounters.
Poisonous Skitterers are common creatures in Naxxramas's Arachnid Quarter.
Crypt Reavers are found in Naxxramas's Arachnid Quarter. A reaver goes into a frenzy.
A Tomb Horror found in Naxxramas, it is a combat creature that casts a spell.
A Naxxramas Cultist found within the necropolis, it casts a spell during combat.
A Naxxramas Acolyte found within the necropolis, it casts a spell during combat.

Sapphiron is undead and dwells in Naxxramas, where he can take flight, attack and enrage. The eye-shaped Key to the Focusing Iris can be recovered from his clutches. Its powerful magical resonance is nearly painful to mortal ears, prompting a request to seek Alexstrasza’s counsel at Wyrmrest Temple.

Kel'Thuzad serves the Lich King and summons minions to heed his call. He tells his master that the time of his enemies' destruction draws close, warns heroes that they will be destroyed by the Lich King's will, and announces his strike.
Loatheb is a Naxxramas encounter boss whose necrotic aura blocks healing. Its power can wane and fade, allowing healing again.
The Patchwork Golem is a Naxxramas construct that casts War Stomp in combat.
Bile Retcher is an encounter creature in Naxxramas that uses Bile Vomit during combat.
A Mad Scientist in Naxxramas who fights with Mana Burn and can cast Great Heal.
A Living Monstrosity of Naxxramas, counted among the Scourge targets in the Dawn's assault; it fights with Chain Lightning.
A Surgical Assistant in Naxxramas that attacks with Mind Flay.
An Embalming Slime in Naxxramas that casts a spell in combat.
A Stitched Giant in Naxxramas that can knock back its target in combat.

Patchwerk is an undead abomination in Naxxramas’s Construct Quarter who calls himself Kel’Thuzad’s avatar of war. He treats fighting as play and speaks in simple, broken phrases. The Council of Six orders his destruction amid reports that he is taking a heavy toll on forces in Dragonblight.
Sludge Belcher uses Acidic Sludge during combat and casts Disease Cloud when reset.
Plague Beast is an undead creature in Naxxramas. It casts Plague Splash when its health is between 0 and 50%.
A bat in Naxxramas’s hostile creature population, distinguished by its frenzied nature. It attacks with Frenzied Dive once combat begins.
A plague-marked bat among Naxxramas’s hostile creatures. Its combat behavior includes attacking with Putrid Bite.
A diseased maggot found among Naxxramas’s hostile creatures. Its identity is defined by its maggot form and disease.
A rotting maggot found among Naxxramas’s hostile creatures. Its identity is defined by its maggot form and decay.

Gothik calls himself the harvester of souls and treats his challengers as invaders who have foolishly challenged powers beyond their understanding. He threatens them with the lonely path of the damned, but his final words concede defeat.

Instructor Razuvious addresses his students, reminding them that he taught them and demanding they apply their practice in combat. His commands and impatient taunts make him a severe, mocking drillmaster, quick to disparage students who disappoint him.

Sir Zeliek is a reluctant combatant who warns intruders to flee or turn back, even as he is compelled to obey. His warnings give way to an apology after a kill, setting him apart from his fellow horsemen.
Thane Korth'azz is a combative horseman who taunts intruders in a rough, blunt manner. He relishes the fight and boasts after a kill, challenging them to return with more allies.

Lady Blaumeux is an eager, competitive horseman who urges Zeliek to let the intruders remain so she can enjoy the fight. She jokes about introducing herself, claims the first kill, and even proposes a wager.
The Deathcharger Steed is a combat mount that charges when it enters combat.
Larva is a critter found across several regions, including Naxxramas.

A Death Knight Captain in Naxxramas, this high-ranking undead combatant uses Plague Strike and can raise the dead in battle. Commander Eligor Dawnbringer’s Echoes of War names Death Knight Captains among the Naxxramas targets.
A Death Knight fighting in Naxxramas, this high-ranking undead combatant uses Death Coil against opponents in battle.
A Risen Squire in Naxxramas, this high-ranking undead combatant uses Pierce Armor against opponents in battle.
A Dark Touched Warrior in Naxxramas, this creature fights with Whirlwind.
A Death Knight Cavalier in Naxxramas, this high-ranking undead combatant uses Bone Armor in battle.
In combat, a Shade of Naxxramas casts Shadow Bolt Volley and opens a Portal of Shadows.
A Necro Knight enters combat.
A Bony Construct attacks in combat with a Brutal Swipe.
A Stoneskin Gargoyle attacks with Acid Volley. Commander Eligor Dawnbringer's Echoes of War names it among the creatures to slay in Naxxramas.
A Skeletal Smith attacks in combat with Crush Armor and Disarm.
An Unholy Axe fights with Whirlwind and Mortal Strike.
An animated weapon in Naxxramas, the Unholy Staff attacks with arcane magic, including explosions, frost nova, and polymorph.
The Unholy Swords are animated weapons encountered in Naxxramas. They attack with cleaving and thrashing strikes.
An eye stalk found in Naxxramas, this creature acts in combat by casting a spell.
A Plague Slime of Naxxramas, it is an elemental creature with a defensive immunity to shadow magic.
An Infectious Ghoul of Naxxramas, it fights as an undead creature and becomes frenzied when badly wounded.
Mutated Grub is a creature that casts a spell during combat.
The Plagued Ghoul can go into a frenzy. On death, it casts Plague contamination.
The Lich King commands Kel’Thuzad to destroy invaders and defend Naxxramas. He declares that his army will eradicate the Alliance and Horde and conquer Azeroth.
Mr. Bigglesworth is a cat in Naxxramas, a small creature rather than a combatant.
An interactive crystal found in Naxxramas.
A Naxxramas combatant known for its massive stomp.
A marauding Naxxramas combatant that springs at those who draw its attention.
An elusive Naxxramas shade that cloaks itself in invisibility while out of combat.
Baron Rivendare confronts those who challenge him, warning that none shall pass and urging them to harness their rage. He sees death as the true test, declaring life meaningless.
